definitions.explanation: The position of lying with one's face and front of body facing upward.

examples.japanese: {仰向|あおむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{仰向|あおむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I lay on my back looking at the sky.

examples.japanese: {仰向|あおむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To stretch in a supine position.

notes:
{仰向|あおむ}け describes the supine position — lying with the face and body facing upward. It contrasts with ⟦{俯|うつぶ}せ→俯せ：05547_utsubuse⟧ (face down, prone).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {仰向|あおむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to lie on one's back
- {仰向|あおむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧: to sleep on one's back
- {仰向|あおむ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to fall backward
- {仰向|あおむ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: supine position

USAGE:
Used in everyday descriptions of body position, medical/health contexts (sleeping posture, exercises), and in narrative writing describing someone who has fallen or is resting.

WRITING:
The reading combines {仰|あお} (to look up) and {向|む}け (facing). Sometimes written in hiragana as あおむけ.
